slices.objective: Make /ask's default async Research job path fall back to the online-evidence-only report when the local corpus/Ollama path raises AIOrchestrationError and online evidence is enabled, so the default Ask flow does not require a pre-ingested corpus or a configured Ollama model on a deployment that enables online evidence.
acceptance: /ask's async job execution path attempts the online-evidence-only report when the local path is unavailable and online evidence is enabled, and persists it as the job's completed result
/ask's synthesis-availability check (whether to submit a job at all) also widens to online evidence, not only the local corpus/Ollama check
the local path's own sanitized error is preserved, never masked by a second online error, when online evidence is unavailable or also fails
Canonical preflight, required CI checks and review must pass at the exact head; no gate may be weakened.

slices.objective: Add a product-native acceptance test for the complete default /ask flow when no local corpus/Ollama is configured: a submitted question starts the real async Research job, the real online-evidence-only fallback runs against a deterministic fake Core CLI subprocess (not a Python-level mock of the fallback itself), the visitor polls GET /ask/session/{id} to a terminal state, and the result shows citations and uncertainty with bounded temp-data cleanup. This slice adds tests only; it does not change production behavior.
acceptance: a test drives the real /ask route (local AI capability genuinely unavailable: no configured model) and the real GET /ask/session/{id} polling route through to a terminal job, with only the external `ke` executable replaced by a deterministic fake and online evidence enabled
the test asserts the completed session's citations (claim -> excerpt -> source link) and disclosed uncertainty/missing-evidence, and that evidence_source is online_evidence_only
the test asserts no bounded temp directory, cache, or ledger created by the run survives after the job reaches a terminal state
Canonical preflight, required CI checks and review must pass at the exact head; no gate may be weakened.

slices.objective: Return a short human-readable label for a Research job's evidence_source value, matching case-insensitively after stripping whitespace: "local_corpus" maps to "Local indexed corpus", "online_evidence_only" maps to "Online evidence only (no local corpus)", and every other value, including None, the empty string, and any unrecognized string, maps to "Unknown evidence source". Supports Ask/Mobile Review provenance disclosure for the completed async Research job payload (evidence_source in research_jobs.py) without needing JavaScript.
acceptance: evidence_source_label returns the exact mapped label for "local_corpus" and "online_evidence_only", matched case-insensitively and after stripping surrounding whitespace
evidence_source_label returns "Unknown evidence source" for None, the empty string, and any other unrecognized value, never raising
Canonical preflight, required CI checks and review must pass at the exact head; no gate may be weakened.

acceptance_examples.why: the only local-corpus value already written by research_jobs.py's presentation payload
the only online-fallback value already written by research_jobs.py's online presentation payload
a session recorded before evidence_source existed must not crash the label lookup
matching must be case-insensitive and tolerate incidental surrounding whitespace
an empty string is a distinct edge from None and must still fail closed to the unknown label

slices.objective: Return a (label, css_class) tuple for a Research Report's research_state, matched case-insensitively after trimming whitespace: researched_answer, partial_answer, insufficient_evidence, blocked and provider_degraded each map to their own fixed label and css_class; every other value, including None, empty string, and any unrecognized string, maps to ("Unknown", "is-unknown"). Supports a server-rendered certainty badge for Layer 1/Layer 2 rendering without JavaScript.
acceptance: research_state_badge returns the exact (label, css_class) pair for researched_answer, partial_answer, insufficient_evidence, blocked and provider_degraded, matched case-insensitively and after stripping surrounding whitespace
research_state_badge returns ("Unknown", "is-unknown") for None, the empty string, and any other unrecognized value, never raising
Canonical preflight, required CI checks and review must pass at the exact head; no gate may be weakened.

acceptance_examples.why: the online-evidence-only fallback's research_state is always partial_answer or insufficient_evidence
AI's research_state values are matched case-insensitively like evidence_source_label
a job record read before research_state is persisted must not crash the badge lookup
a future AI research_state value must fail closed to Unknown rather than raise
surrounding whitespace from a stored or serialized value must not change the match
